# Heater core and A/C problems

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Run the fan for 5 minutes, then turn on AC and keep windows down. [t7]

Remove lower glove box, trim corner pieces, disconnect wiring harness, unbolt three 5.5mm bolts, and extract old blower motor. [t66]

Check AC or heater speeds and watch a video guide to replace the blower motor resistor card. [t632]

[Partial] Verify fan speeds, confirm button operations, then focus diagnosis on the temperature gauge. [t840]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Remove the lower glove box.
2. [Partial] Trim away all remaining corner trim pieces to expose the blower motor housing.
3. Disconnect the electrical wiring harness from the motor.
4. [Partial] Unbolt and remove three 5.5mm (or 7/32 inch) bolts securing the unit.
5. Extract the old blower motor assembly.

_Procedure reported by [t66]._

<details><summary>Alternate procedure [t7] [Partial]</summary>

1. [Partial] Run the fan without AC for 5 minutes with windows down to cool the system.
2. [Partial] Turn on the AC and keep windows down for another 5 minutes.

</details>

<details><summary>Alternate procedure [t632] [Partial]</summary>

1. [Partial] Check if all AC or heater speeds are functioning correctly.
2. Watch the video guide to replace the blower motor resistor card.

</details>

<details><summary>Alternate procedure [t840] [Partial]</summary>

1. Verify the fan speed settings are functioning correctly.
2. Confirm that all directional buttons and defrost functions operate as expected.

</details>

## Tools

- [Partial] Socket set for 5.5mm or 7/32 inch bolts [t66]
- Video player [t632]

## Tips & gotchas

- Wait a while after installation before expecting immediate cold air output. [t7]
- Be prepared to perform 'dash yoga' due to tight access angles. [t66]
- Note that assembly is simply the reverse of removal. [t66]
- [Partial] Note that replacing the card takes approximately 10 minutes. [t632]
- [Partial] If the fan motor is dirty, the new card may pop out again. [t632]
- [Partial] Focus diagnosis on the temperature gauge dial rather than other controls. [t840]

## Common mistakes

- Ordering the wrong resistor if equipped with 'climate control' instead of numbered fan settings. [t7]
